Item 5.02

On August 26, 2026, Micron Technology, Inc. ("Micron" or the “Company”) announced that Manish Bhatia, 54, the Company’s current Executive Vice President, Global Operations, has been appointed as President and Chief Operating Officer of the Company and that Dr. Scott DeBoer, 60, the Company’s current Executive Vice President, Chief Technology and Products Officer, has been appointed President and Chief Technology and Products Officer of the Company, effective immediately.
